incidents.title: Ransomware deployment on FIN-WS-204
incidents.description: Malicious PowerShell script executed on a finance workstation and began encrypting mapped shares.
incidents.initial_access_vector: Phishing lure containing a disguised Adobe PDF and embedded PowerShell payload
incidents.investigation_notes: Domain credential abuse was observed after execution. The threat actor likely moved laterally to file shares before encryption started.

incidents.title: Lateral movement and credential access
incidents.description: Kerberos and local credential access attempts were observed on network services and domain endpoints.
incidents.initial_access_vector: Service account abuse and remote admin credential reuse
incidents.investigation_notes: Evidence suggests credential dumping from the finance workstation followed by lateral movement attempts.

incidents.title: Suspicious beaconing and exfiltration
incidents.description: Beaconing to external infrastructure matched a known malware command-and-control domain.
incidents.initial_access_vector: External C2 and encoded command execution
incidents.investigation_notes: Traffic was isolated from the enterprise edge and no direct data theft was confirmed at this stage.
